title: Step 60-B backend and OpenAPI listing contract readiness
description: Make the public Search/Category/Listing API contract honest and typed before Storefront implementation. Define successful response schemas and cursor semantics for Search, Category products, Category filters and Search suggestions; remove product-list query parameters that the backend does not yet implement; bind ProductCard to canonical refs; expose authoritative inventory-backed in_stock through the Inventory public port; regenerate OpenAPI types; add deterministic contract/runtime regression tests; and keep advanced interactive filtering/sorting implementation reserved for Stage 60-F.

evidence.contract_gap: Search/category/filter/suggestion successful bodies were untyped; /products advertised min_price/max_price/available/sort that CatalogQueryService did not consume; ProductCard in_stock was hard-coded false.
evidence.implementation_boundary: Stage 60-B types and aligns the currently supported contract. Advanced filter and selectable sort behavior remains Stage 60-F.
evidence.design_recovery_sync: Pre-PR deterministic verification exposed Step56 recovered-source hash drift for contracts/http/openapi.yaml and src/modules/catalog/catalog.module.ts. Stage 60-B authorizes minimal refresh of those two source SHA256 entries plus the deterministic Step56-A manifest sourceSha256; no Step56 design semantics are changed.
evidence.bounded_availability_debt: Product-card stock truth uses the canonical Inventory availability port per sellable variant. This is authority-correct but can fan out to multiple bounded reads per card; performance batching is deferred to Step 60-G unless Stage 60 acceptance shows it is required earlier.

acceptance_criteria.description: Fresh live guard proves main exact base, Open PRs zero, relevant Locks released and no competing Task Catalog writer.
Search, Category products, Category filters, Category context and Search suggestions expose explicit successful response schemas in source OpenAPI and generated types.

GET /products no longer advertises min_price, max_price, available or selectable sort before those semantics are implemented; undeclared public listing query keys fail closed instead of being silently ignored.
Search contract includes q plus cursor/limit and keeps backend-owned relevance ordering; category listing includes cursor/limit/brand and keeps backend-owned newest ordering.
Public ProductCard price is explicitly nullable and availability.in_stock is derived through the canonical Inventory availability port, without cross-module repository access.
Category filter values are normalized to arrays and response schemas preserve canonical filter metadata.
src/generated/openapi.ts is byte-for-byte reproducible from contracts/http/openapi.yaml using openapi-typescript 7.13.0.
Root pnpm verify, build and relevant regression tests pass with no Storefront/runtime UI mutation.
Changed files remain exactly within the authorized Stage 60-B write scope.
Step56-A recovered-source evidence is deterministically synchronized for the two intentionally changed recovered sources, with no design-scope or historical-baseline rewrite.
Protected merge transport, exact-SHA postmerge pnpm verify and Phase A pass, then terminal Lock release before 60-C.
